model_annotations.German: Figure 5 presents a line chart comparing the performance of various reinforcement learning methods with and without self-reflection, plotted against training steps on the horizontal axis and performance on the vertical axis, with the latter ranging approximately from 0.7 to 1.0 in linear scale. The chart includes four distinct lines: SRPO (solid blue), SRPO w/o self-reflection (dashed blue), PPO (solid orange), and PPO w/o self-reflection (dashed orange), as indicated by the legend in the upper right corner. The SRPO line exhibits a smooth, steady upward trend, reaching a performance level near 0.95 by the final training step. The SRPO w/o self-reflection line follows a similar trajectory but remains consistently below SRPO, plateauing around 0.9. The PPO line starts lower and rises more gradually, eventually approaching a performance of about 0.88, while the PPO w/o self-reflection line remains the lowest, stabilizing near 0.82. All lines show increasing performance over time, with SRPO consistently outperforming the other methods across the training duration, and the self-reflection variants of both SRPO and PPO demonstrating higher performance than their non-self-reflection counterparts.
